title: 🌌 Neon Lines Over Starry Gradient with JavaScript Canvas ✨
description:
I’ve crafted a stunning Neon Lines Animation using HTML, CSS, and JavaScript! This project features glowing neon lines streaking across a starry gradient background, creating a futuristic, cosmic vibe. The lines shift colors, move dynamically, and reset with random delays for endless variety! 🌠

  • What’s it about? Neon lines flow diagonally over a twinkling starry sky and a smooth gradient, all rendered on a canvas.

  • The result? A captivating, sci-fi-inspired visual that feels alive and immersive.

  • Main key of the code: The NeonLine object manages line movement, color shifts hsl), and glowing effects shadowBlur), paired with a background loop for stars and gradients.

  • How can users benefit? Use it as a bold website background, tweak the colors, speeds, or star count for your style, or dive into canvas animation techniques!
shortDescription: ⚡️ Neon lines dance over a starry gradient sky, built with JS Canvas. Perfect for futuristic designs or learning!
